title: Pokémon TCG Primal Clash Haban Berry Trainer Poke Ball Pattern 111/131
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Pokémon TCG Primal Clash Haban Berry Trainer Poke Ball Pattern 111/131 is a collectible card game item from the Sv: Prismatic Evolutions set released in 2015. Manufactured by The Pokémon Company, this English-language card features a standard size and is made of card stock material. Illustrated by Studio Bora Inc., this common rarity Trainer card showcases a reverse holo finish with a holo design, making it a desirable addition to any Pokémon TCG collection.
